description: Fork the global-best blocked-Householder kernel (brief 0, FP32 cuBLAS trailing). Add per-matrix classify-on-convert: in the SAME pass that casts FP32->TF32/FP16 for the trailing GEMMs (already touches every element), accumulate a cheap per-matrix conditioning stat (column-norm dynamic-range max/min, near-zero-column count). Gather the well-conditioned majority onto fast single-pass TF32/FP16 tensor-core trailing updates and the ill-conditioned minority onto the accurate FP32 path, then scatter back. Uniform TF32 fails the ill-cond n=512 factor residual; per-matrix routing is the unlock for the n=512/1024 cluster (7/12 of geomean) and passes the invariance guard.

Trial 1 (uniform 1xTF32 probe): set allow_tf32=True so every trailing GEMM uses TF32 tensor cores; panel kernel untouched FP32. Validate FAILS (eval 112): at n=512 band/rowscale/mixed exceed factor budget (scaled>20); dense(3.98)/rankdef(14.2)/clustered(11.5)/nearcollinear(5.42)/dense-cond4(2.94) PASS; all n=1024 PASS (<=7.27). Defines the classifier target: must route band+rowscale (and mixed matrices that are band/rowscale) to an accurate path. Next: uniform 2xTF32 (brief 5 proved it passes band/rowscale), then per-matrix routing well->1xTF32 ill->2xTF32.

Trial 2 (uniform 2xTF32 probe): _trailing_update(mode) added with fp32/tf32/tf32x2; ran uniform tf32x2 (truncated TF32 hi/lo split of V and C, 3-term W and 3-term update, drops lo@lo). Residuals drop vs 1xTF32 but n=512 band=25.2 rowscale=22.3 mixed=20.8 still exceed the 20 budget -> validate FAILS. torch.bmm 2xTF32 is borderline-insufficient for band/rowscale at n=512; the accurate path must be genuine FP32. Next: per-matrix classifier routing the well-conditioned majority to 1xTF32 and band/rowscale/hard matrices to FP32.

Trial 4 (per-matrix routing, FUSED single pipeline): classify each matrix (row/col-norm dynamic range + density, one reduction pass) -> well majority 1xTF32 tensor-core trailing GEMMs, ill minority FP32; mixed batches reorder well-first ONCE so trailing GEMM splits at a contiguous slice boundary (panel kernel runs once over full batch, no duplication), inverse-permute result. n<512 stays FP32. PASS all 22 tests + all 3 guards (invariance/diff/offgrid CLEAN). Geomean 16495us = 1.02x over parent 16835. n512 dense 27440->25511, n512 mixed 27418->26999, n1024 dense 43655->41615, n1024 mixed 43675->42708; ill shapes unchanged (FP32). nsys @ n512 dense: trailing GEMMs are now genuine cutlass tensorop TF32 (~11%), but panel_factor_kernel is 82% and dominates - the trailing-GEMM precision win is capped by the panel kernel. Classify overhead ~2.5%. Next on-brief: FP16 well path; fuse the classify reductions. Bigger lever (off this brief): faster panel kernel (brief 0 trials 2-4 got it 2x faster) would let the TF32 routing pay off far more - a combine candidate.

Trial 5 (FP16 well-path probe): _WELL_MODE=fp16 casts V,C to half for the well group's trailing GEMMs (FP16 mma, FP32 acc) vs trial-4's 1xTF32. PASS all tests+guards. Geomean 17361us vs trial-4 16495 -> REGRESSION (1.05x slower). n512 dense 25511->31417 WORSE: per-panel .half()/.float() cast elementwise kernels outweigh FP16's 2x tensor-core peak because the trailing GEMM is only ~11% of n=512 (panel kernel 82%); TF32 needs no cast (allow_tf32 flag on FP32 inputs) and is faster. Confirms TF32 is the right well-path precision here. Reverting _WELL_MODE to tf32 for the keeper.

Trial 6 (TF32 keeper + loosened classifier): reverted _WELL_MODE to tf32 (FP16 was slower); loosened classifier so ONLY proven 1xTF32 failures route to FP32 - band (density~0.06<0.3) and rowscale (row_dr>30); rankdef(14.2)/clustered(11.5)/nearcollinear(5.42) now take the fast TF32 path. PASS all 22 tests + all 3 guards (invariance_guard injects fully-rank-deficient matrices at n=512 sweeping fraction/position -> confirms rankdef-on-TF32 safe; diff guard 8 extra seeds/shape CLEAN). Geomean 16403us = 1.026x over parent 16835 (best so far). clustered shape10 27239->25510 now TF32; rankdef shape9 ~unchanged (trailing cols are zero, GEMM already cheap). Remaining bottleneck: panel_factor_kernel is 82% of n=512 (off this brief's trailing-update scope). Open: combine with brief-0's faster panel kernel (trials 2-4 made it ~2x faster) to let TF32 routing pay off more; widen panel for the well group.

Trial 7 (leaner classifier): classify on two lean stats off one abs view - per-row max-abs dynamic range (flags rowscale) and density (flags band); dropped the per-column 2-norm reduction (only caught clustered, which passes 1xTF32). PASS all 22 tests + all 3 guards. Geomean 16218us = 1.038x over parent 16835 (best). rankdef shape9 26528->24475 (now cleanly on TF32), dense shape3 25529->25230, mixed shape7 26893->26403. Fewer classify reduction kernels + rankdef on fast path. Bottleneck still panel_factor (~82% n=512). Open: combine with brief-0's faster panel kernel; avoid the mixed-shape permute copies; widen well-group panel.

Trial 8 (skip redundant clone on mixed path): _blocked_qr(inplace=True) factors the already-fresh permuted copy in place, removing one full B*n*n clone on mixed shapes. PASS all tests+guards (diff guard CLEAN - in-place target is the permuted copy, not caller input). Geomean 16216us (flat vs trial-7 16218, within noise). Mixed shape7 26403->26293, shape8 42502->42363. The inverse-permute gather (Hp[inv], ~1.7%) still dominates mixed-shape routing overhead. panel_factor still ~79-82%.

Per-matrix classify-on-convert routing BUILT, validated, benchmarked. KEEPER cce8a74dd: geomean 16198-16216us = 1.038x over parent 16835 (brief-0 trial1, 51535ced), PASS all 22 tests + all 3 guards (invariance/diff/offgrid CLEAN). Classify each matrix on its own content (one abs-view pass: per-row max-abs dynamic range flags rowscale, density flags band) -> well majority gets 1xTF32 tensor-core trailing GEMMs, only band/rowscale -> FP32; mixed batches reorder well-first ONCE and split the trailing GEMM at a contiguous boundary (panel kernel runs once over full batch, factored in place), inverse-permute result. Per-shape vs parent: n512 dense 27440->25230, n512 mixed 27418->26293, n512 rankdef 26664->24475, n512 clustered 27477->25273, n1024 dense 43655->41352, n1024 mixed 43675->42363, n1024 nearrank 43699->41193. Trials: T1 uniform 1xTF32 FAILS only band/rowscale/mixed@n512 (the classifier target); T2 uniform 2xTF32 (torch.bmm hi/lo split) borderline-insufficient (band 25.2 vs 20); T4 routing+FUSED pipeline (the double-pipeline split halved occupancy and REGRESSED mixed shapes 2x - avoided); T5 FP16 well-path SLOWER than TF32 (per-panel cast kernels outweigh 2x peak since GEMM is only ~11%); T6 loosened classifier (rankdef/clustered onto TF32, guard-confirmed safe); T7 leaner 2-stat classifier (best); T8 skip redundant mixed clone. PROFILE (nsys n512): panel_factor_kernel is 82-83% and is the wall - trailing GEMMs are now genuine cutlass TF32 tensorop (~10%) so the precision routing is MAXED within this parent. BIGGEST OPEN DIRECTION (off this brief's trailing-update scope, needs a new brief): combine this routing with brief-0's faster panel kernel (its trials 2-4 made panel_factor ~2x faster, reaching 7759us total) - once the panel is fast the trailing GEMM becomes a large fraction and TF32 routing pays off far more; that is the multiplier. Other open levers: cut the mixed-shape inverse-permute gather (~1.7%); widen the well-group panel (nb) now that its trailing update is cheap TF32; route the well group's PANEL factorization itself onto tensor cores (a wider structural change). The n=2048/4096 geqrf shapes (77k/52k) now dominate the geomean and are off this brief (brief-4 lane).
